# Termux-Vision (v1.0.0)
> Zero-Dependency On-Device Computer Vision & Multimodal VLM Inference Engine for Android Termux

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-vision
- Installation: `pip install ameva-core
# or: npm install @ameva/core`
- Architecture: Eliminates heavy C++ dependencies by compiling SIMD NEON vision kernels directly with zero-copy image transforms, delivering real-time object detection, segmentation, and VLM multimodal inference under 150MB RAM.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import termux_vision as vision

# 1. Load zero-dependency mobile vision engine
engine = vision.VisionEngine(model="nanodet-plus-arm64")

# 2. Run real-time detection on mobile image
results = engine.detect("sample.jpg", conf_threshold=0.45)
for obj in results:
    print(f"Detected: {obj.label} ({obj.score:.2f}) at {obj.bbox}")

```
